commits.message:
docs(env): document credential and picker invariants (#1206)

## Summary

Recover four comments that document existing credential and picker
boundaries:

- Operator environment declarations can contain credential material and
stay within Rust.
- Credential declarations follow the resolved launch instance and its
existing routing rules.
- A per-reference 1Password account overrides the instance default.
- The operator picker deserializes metadata only; secret values stay out
of its model.

No executable code changed.

## Validation

- Normal pre-commit passed the `jackin-env` formatter, `cargo check`,
and Clippy tasks, plus Gitleaks and Kingfisher.
- Normal pre-push passed Betterleaks with no findings.

---------

Signed-off-by: Alexey Zhokhov <alexey@zhokhov.com>
